smoke.notes: All 5 raw scout JSONs parse: V-JEPA_2_JEPA_world_mode.json (4 results), test-time_training_layer.json (7), knowledge_distillation_L.json (7), hyperdimensional_computi.json (8), continual_learning_from_.json (5, all junk — receipted below). This is an IDEAS-corpus work: the decomposed objects are research abstracts, not code, so no runtime smoke exists beyond receipt integrity.

essence: out-of-superinstance research moorings: five raw web-search receipts the garden synthesized into design justifications — one channel returned junk and was receipted, not hidden

ideas.name: latent prediction is the world-model mainstream
ideas.statement: The JEPA line is confirmed as the frontier: V-JEPA 2 physics-guided video embeddings, ThinkJEPA (latent world models + VLM reasoning), Human-JEPA built from V-JEPA 2.1 by anchored forecasting — so the garden's Task A (next-receipt latent prediction) and quilt-jepa are on the mainstream line, not an off-grid bet.

ideas.name: test-time training legitimizes idle-time compile
ideas.statement: TTT-E2E retrains at inference via meta-learning and Buffer layers adapt at inference while the backbone stays frozen — so the garden's weaver (idle-time compile instead of in-forward gradient steps) is 'TTA at the system level', a training regime rather than a compromise; the weave artifact IS the compiled adaptation.

ideas.name: escalation distillation as the practical living loop
ideas.statement: Teacher-to-student distillation (Qwen3-VL-235B to 2B; LLM agents distilled into small retrieval-backed models) is the pattern behind the escalation organ: judge locally (0.056ms), escalate the uncertain to a hosted JEV (283ms, receipted), distill at idle into the local weave — the garden owns that loop end-to-end with usage receipts.

ideas.name: HDC/VSA as the gradient-free representation answer
ideas.statement: Hyperdimensional computing represents information as high-dim hypervectors with bundling/binding ops and no backprop — the established science for 'embedding without gradient orthodoxy'; the garden's qthe arm is a QTHE-flavored HDC substrate, and THDC justifies training-free prototype growth as a first-class method (priced honestly: P-G1(b) PASS, then lost the bake-off to the hashed head).

ideas.name: the dud channel and the novel part
ideas.statement: The continual-learning query returned pure junk (a Toyota production-system PPT, Philippine history, RuneScape gloves, SVN commit diffs) — the second failure of that channel on production-ML phrasing — receipted rather than deleted; consequently growth-from-usage has NO external anchor and is the part the garden builds novel, with pre-registered claims instead of citations.

parts.name: raw-search-receipt substrate
parts.essence: Every scout query archives its raw JSON result dump (url, name, snippet, host, rank, date) under scouts/raw/ before any synthesis — the senses keep receipts, so synthesis can be audited against what the search actually returned.
parts.gate: raw receipts are archived before synthesis is written
parts.failure_mode: synthesizing from memory with no auditable receipt of what was seen
parts.evidence: jev-garden/scouts/raw/ (5 files); scout report header 'Raw search receipts: scouts/raw/*.json (5 queries...)'

parts.name: hit-to-garden mapping rows
parts.essence: The scout report is a table where each external line names exactly what it gives the garden (HDC -> 'THDC justifies training-free prototype growth'; TTT -> 'the garden's weaver = TTA at the system level'; JEPA -> 'Task A IS next-receipt latent prediction') — import with a stated use, never import for prestige.
outputs: one garden-use row per research line
parts.gate: a hit enters synthesis only with a named 'what it gives the garden'
parts.failure_mode: citation theater — collecting papers with no design consequence

parts.name: V-JEPA 2 lineage claims
parts.essence: Human-JEPA 'built from the released V-JEPA 2.1 (Mur-Labadia et al., 2026) by anchored forecasting with two changes and one omission' (arxiv, Aug 2026); LeCun/AMI Labs JEPA with '1.5-6x training efficiency' (zylos.ai); ThinkJEPA latent world models + large VLM reasoning (github, Mar 2026); V-JEPA 2 'dual loss combining diffusion and physics regression' (emergentmind).
parts.failure_mode: treating marketing snippets as paper-grade evidence (these are REPORTED-grade hits)

parts.name: borrowed: mainstream-line confirmation
parts.essence: What the fleet took: confirmation that predict-in-embedding-space is the world-model mainstream — 'the garden's Task A IS next-receipt latent prediction; quilt-jepa (our repo) is the cell-mesh cousin.' Borrowed as orientation, not origin.
outputs: design justification for Task A + quilt-jepa
parts.failure_mode: claiming novelty where the frontier already agrees (or originality where it already converged)

parts.name: unexplored: JEPA at cell tempo
parts.essence: What remains untouched: no fleet cell predicts in embedding space at cell tempo, and the ensemble/memory-prior hypothesis is unpaid — three honest FAILs say the current soil 'saturates too easily for memory-priors to pay' (P-G2d queued).
parts.failure_mode: declaring parity with V-JEPA without a hard-world test
parts.evidence: jev-garden/scouts/2026-09-28-living-jev-research.md 'Where we are ahead / behind' (three honest FAILs, P-G2d queued)

parts.name: TTT lineage claims
parts.essence: TTT-E2E 'retrains model... at inference time' via meta-learning ('the model learns how to learn from input provided at inference time', charonhub); Buffer layers: 'a lightweight parallel module that adapts at inference while keeping the backbone frozen' (openreview, cited by 7); 'TTT with KV binding... is commonly interpreted as a form of online meta-learning' (alphaxiv).
parts.failure_mode: conflating TTT layers with full-model retraining

parts.name: borrowed: idle-compile as regime
parts.essence: What the fleet took: TTT/TTA 'legitimizes idle-time compilation as a training regime, not a compromise. The weave artifact = the compiled adaptation' — the garden's watch->deform->observe->idle-compile loop is the system-level analogue of a buffer layer.
outputs: justification for the weaver's idle-compile stage
parts.failure_mode: apologizing for idle-compile as second-class training

parts.name: unexplored: in-forward vs amortized
parts.essence: What remains untouched: the garden never does gradient steps in the serving path — the untested claim is whether idle-amortized compilation matches in-forward adaptation on the garden's receipt stream, and at what cadence compile should re-run.
parts.failure_mode: assuming equivalence without a queued experiment
parts.evidence: jev-garden/scouts/2026-09-28-living-jev-research.md TTT row ('same amortization goal' — equivalence asserted, not measured)

parts.name: distillation lineage claims
parts.essence: Teacher->student at scale: 'Teacher = large model (Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B); Student = small model (Qwen3-VL-2B)' (dev.to); 'Distilling LLM Agent into Small Models with Retrieval' toward on-device small language agents (openreview, cited by 44); knowledge graphs as 'structured, auditable repositories... verification signals' (ssrn).
parts.failure_mode: distilling into students with no auditable verification signal

parts.name: borrowed: the escalation organ
parts.essence: What the fleet took: 'The teacher->student pattern behind the escalation organ: hosted JEV labels escalate; idle compile distills into the local weave. The garden implements the loop with usage receipts (pricing-first)' — local judgment 0.056ms vs escalated 283ms, both receipted.
outputs: escalation organ: local judge -> hosted labeler -> idle distill
parts.gate: every escalation carries a usage receipt (pricing-first)
parts.failure_mode: unmetered escalation to the hosted teacher

parts.name: unexplored: second-generation distill
parts.essence: What remains untouched: distillation quality against the garden's hashed-head baseline is unresolved (the qthe arm lost the bake-off), and no student-of-the-student (second-generation) distill has been measured on the receipt stream.
parts.failure_mode: assuming the distilled student beats the cheap head it lost to
parts.evidence: jev-garden/scouts/2026-09-28-living-jev-research.md synthesis point 1 ('lost to the hashed head — the honest bake-off verdict')

parts.name: HDC lineage claims
parts.essence: THDC: 'Hyperdimensional computing (HDC) offers lightweight learning for energy-constrained devices by encoding data into high-dimensional vectors' (arxiv 2602.00116, Jan 2026); ACM survey on HDC/VSA; 'HD/VSA do not rely on backpropagation' (hd-computing.com); IBM NeuroVSA: 'information is superposed... Learning is incremental and fast'.
parts.failure_mode: overselling HDC as a general replacement for neural nets

parts.name: borrowed: qthe as QTHE-flavored HDC
parts.essence: What the fleet took: 'The garden's qthe arm is a QTHE-flavored HDC substrate; THDC justifies training-free prototype growth as a first-class method, not a hack' — growth by accumulation instead of gradient descent, exactly what a receipt-fed living model can do at quilt tempo.
parts.failure_mode: treating gradient-free growth as a hack needing apology

parts.name: unexplored: VSA-native receipt features
parts.essence: What remains untouched: the garden's 16-dim 'native' fingerprint is hand-rolled, not VSA-native — bundling/binding ops are not yet applied to receipt-chain features, so the structural index does not yet use the machinery it cites.
parts.failure_mode: citing VSA while indexing with ad-hoc fingerprints
parts.evidence: jev-garden/scouts/2026-09-28-living-jev-research.md HDC row; tidepool README 'native is an optional 16-number domain fingerprint' (si-fleet) shows the hand-rolled state

parts.name: the junk channel receipt
parts.essence: continual_learning_from_.json archived 5 results and none are about continual learning: a Toyota production-system slide deck, a 2009 SVN dictionary diff, de Morga's 'History of the Philippine Islands', OSRS Swift-gloves, a RichFaces commit — the query phrasing failed, second time on that channel, and the junk is kept as a receipt.
outputs: a receipted dud, not a silent gap
parts.gate: junk results are receipted and named in the report, never silently dropped
parts.failure_mode: query-phrasing drift poisoning the scout lane invisibly (exactly what receipting prevents)
parts.evidence: jev-garden/scouts/raw/continual_learning_from_.json (5 junk results as read); scout report header 'the continual-learning phrasing returned junk — receipted, 2nd time that channel is weak'

parts.name: borrowed: nothing — the novel part
parts.essence: The consequence of the dud: 'Growth-from-usage: (junk receipted) — No crisp external reference found — this is the part we're building novel, with pre-registered claims instead of citations' — the only garden pillar whose justification is prospective rather than borrowed.
parts.gate: an unanchored pillar must carry pre-registered claims, not borrowed citations
parts.failure_mode: backfilling fake citations for the novel part

parts.name: the honest ahead/behind interface
parts.essence: The scout report ends with an ahead/behind section stated plainly: ahead on provenance-grade training data (the growth journal IS the field, hash-chained), determinism crown (P-G5 byte-identical cross-substrate), judgment lifecycle law; behind on scale ('1418 rows is a windowsill, not a greenhouse') and on the ensemble hypothesis (three honest FAILs).
outputs: a self-assessment a stranger can check
parts.failure_mode: scout reports that only flatter the design they serve

cells.expr: hit -> what it gives the garden
qthe = QTHE-flavored HDC; growth by accumulation

layer_logic.0: substrate = unedited raw search receipts archived before synthesis — the scout lane's chain of custody
layer_logic.1: mechanism = four research lines (JEPA, TTT, distillation, HDC) read as dated hit lists and mapped row-by-row onto garden design
layer_logic.2: policy = a hit must name what it gives the garden; borrowed vs unexplored is stated per line; an unanchored pillar must be pre-registered, not cited
layer_logic.3: interface = the ahead/behind self-report — the garden's honest face toward the frontier
layer_logic.4: evidence = the junk channel kept as a receipt (5 named duds), proving the lane receipts failures as carefully as hits
